owner.description: the person or org holding it; required when the status is waiting-on-them

since.description: when it entered this state, at the precision the source establishes: a bare year (YYYY), a year-month (YYYY-MM), a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), or an ISO-8601 datetime with an offset - never invent precision the source does not have. An offset-bearing datetime renders relatively ("6 days ago"); a day renders as "since <day>"; a year or year-month renders as itself

due_at.description: deadline for this item: an offset-bearing ISO-8601 datetime when the minute is known, or a bare YYYY-MM-DD day when only the day is known

next_check_at.description: when to check this item again: an offset-bearing ISO-8601 datetime when the minute is known, or a bare YYYY-MM-DD day when only the day is known

items.description: the open loops; items may be empty only when empty is set; every visible character in this array counts against one 600-character collection budget, and that budget binds before the item cap - short items reach the cap, long items do not

empty.description: shown when items has none; items may be empty only when empty is set

components.name: streak-grid
components.description: Inspect daily activity patterns through calendar position and relative intensity when cadence or consistency matters more than precise comparison. Optional days (7-371) draws a last-N-days window ending on the reader's today, or on end, from cells that name only active days.
components.interaction: Scroll the calendar locally; cells are display-only and cannot record activity.

confusable_with.name: progress
confusable_with.note: progress compares a value with a target; streak-grid reveals activity cadence and intensity by day.

confusable_with.name: chart
confusable_with.note: chart plots magnitudes over labels; streak-grid shows daily activity through calendar position and relative intensity.

confusable_with.name: table
confusable_with.note: streak-grid reveals daily cadence and intensity; table supports exact lookup across shared fields.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; one cell per day, and the cell's identity

value.description: non-negative intensity for that day; 0 records no activity, an absent date has no observation

cells.description: one cell per date, each date once: at most 371 cells spanning at most 371 days from the earliest to the latest. Cells may be empty only when empty is set; every visible character in this array counts against one 600-character collection budget, and that budget binds before the item cap - short items reach the cap, long items do not

days.description: draw a fixed window of the last N days (7-371) ending at end, so cells may name only the days with activity; omit it to let the cells describe their own range

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last day of the days window; omit it and the window ends on the reader's own today

empty.description: shown when cells has none; cells may be empty only when empty is set

components.name: table
components.description: Compare aligned records or attributes on shared fields when exact lookup and side-by-side comparison matter to the reader.
components.interaction: Scroll wide tables and copy marked columns; no sorting, filtering, or editing.

confusable_with.name: decision
confusable_with.note: decision explains alternatives and their tradeoffs; table aligns shared fields for exact comparison.

confusable_with.name: facts
confusable_with.note: facts presents named values independently; table aligns shared fields across records or attributes.

confusable_with.name: chart
confusable_with.note: chart emphasizes numerical patterns; table keeps exact values aligned for lookup and comparison.

confusable_with.name: streak-grid
confusable_with.note: streak-grid reveals daily cadence and intensity; table supports exact lookup across shared fields.

confusable_with.name: grid
confusable_with.note: grid gives a few values equal prominence; table aligns shared fields for exact comparison.

confusable_with.name: comparison
confusable_with.note: comparison stacks a before and after value per row for a phone; table keeps several shared fields aligned side by side.

confusable_with.name: item-list
confusable_with.note: item-list scans rows with one trailing value; table aligns several shared fields across records.

columns.description: header labels, left to right; use "" for the empty corner of a comparison matrix

cells.description: one value per column, in order; use {value,unit} and {amount,currency} rather than formatting numbers yourself

rows.description: one row per record; row ids are unique, every row carries one cell per column, and rows may be empty only when empty is set; every visible character in this array counts against one 600-character collection budget, and that budget binds before the item cap - short items reach the cap, long items do not

highlight_column.description: zero-based index of the column to mark as the pick

copyable_columns.description: zero-based indices of columns whose values the reader will paste elsewhere; repeats are ignored

key_column.description: the column name that identifies a row; must name one of columns. Heads each stacked facts block when presentation is records

presentation.description: how to draw this; leave null to let the device choose the presentation that fits the data and the reader's screen

empty.description: shown when rows has none; rows may be empty only when empty is set

components.name: timeline
components.description: Follow an ordered sequence of events or stages, preserving only the dates and times the source establishes.
components.interaction: Tap a linked event to open its destination; the sequence itself cannot be rescheduled or completed from the page.

confusable_with.name: status-list
confusable_with.note: status-list tracks independently owned open work; timeline orders related events or stages.

confusable_with.name: checklist
confusable_with.note: checklist emphasizes recorded completion; timeline emphasizes the order in which events or stages occur.

confusable_with.name: phases
confusable_with.note: phases groups contiguous stretches toward a date and derives the current one; timeline follows discrete dated events or stages in order.

order.description: reading direction; defaults to ascending. descending for a newest-first history, as-provided when the source order is meaningful or the events are undated

at.description: when it happened, at the precision the source establishes: a bare year (YYYY), a year-month (YYYY-MM), a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), or an ISO-8601 datetime with an offset - never invent precision the source does not have; omit only when the sequence is intentionally undated

time.description: HH:MM local wall-clock time; use with a date-only at, or alone when the surrounding page already establishes the day

page.description: id of another Strata page; the server resolves its keyed URL, so never paste one

url.description: http(s) URL of an external destination

events.description: the events in the order given; unless order is as-provided, every event needs at or time, and the whole timeline uses one time form. Events may be empty only when empty is set; every visible character in this array counts against one 600-character collection budget, and that budget binds before the item cap - short items reach the cap, long items do not

empty.description: shown when events has none; events may be empty only when empty is set
